description: Recent neuron registration events across all subnets or for a specified subnet, with registration burn cost in TAO, netuid, uid, hotkey, and coldkey. Requires TAOSTATS_API_KEY. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_subtensor_events when you need Recent Subtensor chain events, optionally filtered; crypto_subtensor_block_events when you need events of a single Bittensor Subtensor block by block. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: crypto_subtensor_registrations
title: Recent neuron registration events across all subnets
